description: Fictional resume text paired with expected extraction fields. All names are illustrative, email addresses use the reserved .invalid domain, and phone numbers use reserved 555-01xx examples.

labelDefinitions.skills: Explicitly named skills supported by the resume text; not a proficiency assessment.
labelDefinitions.emailAddresses: Email strings visibly present in the resume text.
labelDefinitions.phoneNumbers: Phone strings visibly present in the resume text.
labelDefinitions.sectionHeadingsPresent: Canonical section labels corresponding to visibly present headings.
labelDefinitions.textCharacters: JavaScript string length of the provided text, including whitespace and line breaks.
labelDefinitions.confidence: Heuristic labels, not calibrated probabilities. Contact confidence reflects regex matches; skills confidence is model-derived and should be reviewed.
